21.item: Saluum lotum, saluum lotum (second baptism of blood)
21.sense_relied_on: the crowd roars the saved-washed of Saturus's blood-baptism

21.item: ansulam de digito ... uulneri mersam (kept spelling ansulam)
21.sense_relied_on: the ring dipped in his wound, returned as inheritance and pledge

21.item: errantem dexteram tirunculi ... ipsa in iugulum suum transtulit
21.sense_relied_on: she set the recruit's erring right hand to her own throat — such a woman could not otherwise be killed
